summary.name: AIMLAPI
summary.one_liner: AIMLAPI is a hosted API gateway that gives access to 1000+ AI models (chat, reasoning, image, video, audio, voice, search) through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint and one bill.
use_cases: Switch between multiple LLM providers without changing code
Add chat, image, video or audio generation to an app
Connect AI agents like Cursor to model APIs via MCP
Prototype and scale AI features from proof-of-concept to production
Consolidate AI model billing under one account
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a single API endpoint (api.aimlapi.com/v1) that exposes over 1000 models across chat, reasoning, image, video, audio, voice, search and embeddings. Developers use the OpenAI client library by changing base_url and model string, and the page states OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility. It also offers an MCP server (mcp.aimlapi.com/mcp) that can be added to clients such as Cursor using a Bearer API key, letting agents list models, run chat completions and check balance. A sandbox is available for testing models before integration. The page lists a 99.9% uptime SLA and mentions low latency and no usage limits on one tier.
notable: Single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for 1000+ models, switchable by changing the model string
Hosted MCP server that agent clients such as Cursor can connect to
Sandbox environment to test models before integrating
caveats: Enterprise tier features (dedicated servers, custom models, unlimited RPM/TPM) are described only as contact-sales options; pricing is not stated on the page
Paid usage is implied ('pay only for what you use'); exact prices are not listed on the page
Some plan features such as crypto payments and priority support are listed without detailed terms
